# Charlie Sloane

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is a boy characterized by his distinctive goggle eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors ambitious career goals for his future. He intends to enter politics with the specific objective of becoming a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. He attends class alongside other local students during the academic year under the instruction of Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and later Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). During their time at school, Charlie and his peers engage in minor classroom feuds while pursuing their studies and creative activities like story writing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
